bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children; appropriating money for food assistance.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; EVERY MEAL.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to Every Meal to provide children and families experiencing food insecurity with access to nutritious and culturally appropriate food over the weekend.
